changelog.text:
### Improved
- Improvements and bug fixes.

### Improved
- The app interface has been updated with a cleaner and more consistent layout.
- Spacing within settings panels and groups has been standardized for a more polished look.

### Improved
- Refreshed the layout margins and spacing inside panels for a cleaner look.

### Improved
- Security checks now run more reliably to ensure license keys are properly validated.
- The app now correctly handles license status updates even when online payment features are temporarily disabled.

### New
- The app now automatically verifies your license status to keep your access up to date.
- Added a clear notification message if your license key is disabled by the administrator.
### Improved
- Updated the "About" window with a cleaner, more readable layout.
- Refreshed the "Buy" and "Plan" screens for a more consistent and modern look (Pro/Trial).
- All dialog windows now feature consistent title bars that match your selected theme.
- Improved the clarity of status messages when purchasing or restoring a license (Pro/Trial).

### New
- Added automatic license checks during use to instantly lock the app if blocked by the administrator [Pro / Trial].
### Improved
- Updated the About window with a clean, streamlined layout and non-selectable text.
- Refreshed dialog themes and title bars to match the current app appearance.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where expired or mismatched payment orders could cause display glitches.

### New
- Added a thumbnail maker with Khmer text styles (Pro).
- Added a video recap feature to summarize long videos (Pro).
- Added AI voice detection so Gemini can better distinguish between male and female speakers.
- Added support for buying or renewing your license online via KHQR.
- The app now automatically splits lines if both a man and a woman speak in the same segment.
### Improved
- You can now save your favorite conversion settings to load them later.
- Improved the app's look with consistent dark title bars on all windows.
- Added clearer instructions if your Gemini API key runs into issues.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where vocal removal could cause the app to crash.
- The app now automatically switches to a backup voice if the primary voice service is temporarily unavailable.

### New
- Added a video recap feature to summarize long videos into short highlights [Pro].
- Added a thumbnail maker with full Khmer text shaping and custom styles [Pro].
- Added online payments and license renewals using KHQR bank codes.
### Improved
- Improved voice detection to automatically split lines when both a man and a woman speak in the same sentence.
- Added AI voice verification using Gemini to confirm correct male and female voices.
- Upgraded the default Gemini model to Gemini 3.5 Flash for faster and higher-quality translations.
- Added settings favorites so you can save and reload your preferred conversion settings.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where Edge-TTS occasionally failed to generate audio for certain lines.

### New
- Added a dedicated window for managing your Gemini API key with step-by-step instructions.
### Improved
- Speeded up video translation significantly by optimizing parallel batch processing and AI settings.
- Updated shortcuts and app names cleanly across updates.
- Refined API key checking for faster and clearer status feedback.

### New
- Added a dedicated window for managing your Gemini API key with step-by-step setup instructions.
- Added support for entering multiple API keys (Pro).
### Improved
- Speed up video translation significantly by running multiple batches in parallel across available API keys.
- Speed up key validation checks by optimizing Google AI communication.
- Refreshed desktop shortcuts and icons automatically during updates.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where expired or blocked admin API keys were not cleared correctly.

### New
- Added a dedicated window for managing Gemini API keys with step-by-step instructions and secure key masking.
- Added an option to automatically open the output folder when a conversion is finished.
### Improved
- Speeded up translation by sending multiple batches in parallel across all your configured API keys.
- Improved automatic speaker gender and voice detection using advanced pitch and timbre analysis.
- Optimized Gemini translation settings to respond faster without reducing quality.
- Updated the API key check to test multiple keys at once and reject invalid keys immediately.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where the app could crash or fail if program files were modified or damaged.

### New
- Added a setting to automatically open the output folder when a video translation is finished [Standard, Pro, Trial].
### Improved
- Upgraded speaker gender detection for much higher accuracy, better handling of overlapping voices, and smarter grouping of speakers by pitch and voice color.
- Redesigned the editor tabs to fit nicely and share the full window width.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where minor pitch fluctuations could occasionally misidentify speaker genders in challenging audio.

### New
- Added a full video editor to customize your videos with text layers, blur boxes, color filters, image overlays, and sponsors (Pro).
- Added support for hardware-accelerated video rendering using NVIDIA, Intel, and AMD graphics chips for much faster export speeds.
- Added live preview support for dragging and positioning subtitles, logos, and custom text layers directly on the video.
- Added automatic detection to fall back to the original audio track if separated voice tracks are too quiet.
### Improved
- Improved Khmer speech recognition and translation accuracy by using all available CPU threads and better handling of silent audio tracks.
- Updated Khmer subtitle formatting with support for rounded background boxes, custom outlines, shadows, and precise line breaking.
- Updated app shortcuts on your Desktop and Start menu to automatically display the current version number.
- Updated license and update checking to support remote key revocations and enhanced security integrity checks.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where Windows text players would sometimes fail to display Khmer Unicode characters correctly in exported subtitle files.
- Fixed character order and word spacing issues for Khmer text layers and subtitles.

### New
- Added a full video editor right below the preview to add custom text layers, blur sensitive areas, sponsor pictures, frames, and colour filters.
- Added support for Facebook Reel, 1:1 square, and custom preview shapes from the window menu.
### Improved
- Speeded up video transcription and rendering by automatically utilizing all CPU cores and graphics card hardware acceleration.
- Made vocal removal smarter by automatically rechecking the original audio if the separated voice track is too quiet.
- Refreshed the user interface with a cleaner menu layout and improved tab styling.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where videos with very quiet or missing vocal separation tracks failed to transcribe speech properly.

### New
- Added a full video editor [Pro] to add custom text, blur boxes to hide original text, sponsor images, and overlay frames.
- Added support for hardware-accelerated video rendering [Pro/Trial] using your graphics chip for much faster export.
### Improved
- Improved Khmer speech recognition and translation accuracy by automatically checking both the separated voice track and original audio.
- Updated Khmer text shaping and hyphenation to ensure subtitles and custom text wrap correctly without breaking words.
- Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts now automatically keep the correct version number when updated.
### Fixed
- Fixed an issue where very quiet separated voice tracks could cause translation or transcription to fail.
- Fixed a bug with subtitle file encoding so Khmer characters now display correctly across all Windows media players.

### New
- Added a full menu bar (File, Action, Window, Help) for quicker access to all features and settings.
- Added Settings Dialog to configure all preferences in a dedicated window.
- Added Khmer Subtitle Preview to view and position subtitles directly on a still video frame [(Pro)].
- Added support for alternative Khmer subtitle styles including a background box or clean outlined text [(Pro)].
- Added Developer Tools for turning images into app icons [(Pro)].
### Improved
- Completely overhauled Khmer text processing with accurate Unicode character ordering, proper line breaking between words, and HarfBuzz shaping.
- Updated video rendering to draw subtitles using Qt with custom outlines, shadows, and alignment [(Pro)].
- Renamed application shortcuts automatically on updates for easier identification.
### Fixed
- Fixed Khmer text wrapping so lines never break inside a letter cluster.
- Fixed subtitle file exporting to include the proper UTF-8 with BOM encoding for Windows video players.

### New
- Mirror video option to flip footage horizontally while keeping subtitles and logos readable.
- Interactive video preview to visually drag, position, and resize logos and subtitles. (Pro)
- New subtitle styles allowing you to choose between blur bands, background boxes, or clean outlined text. (Pro)
- Dedicated contact window with quick links to Telegram, phone, and email for licensing and support.
- Batch processing control to choose how many queued videos run at the same time. (Pro)
### Improved
- Subtitle line wrapping now breaks naturally between Khmer words without splitting letter clusters.
- Expanded subtitle styling options, including Khmer font selection, alignment, shadows, and outline thickness. (Pro)
- Streamlined interface featuring a top menu bar and a dedicated settings window.
- Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts now automatically update with the current app version.
### Fixed
- Exported Khmer subtitle (.srt) files now open reliably in Windows media players without character corruption.

### New
- Interactively drag and resize your logo directly on a preview frame of your video (Pro).
- Flip your video horizontally with the new Mirror Video option without reversing subtitles or logos.
- Easily reach support via Telegram, phone, or email using the new Contact Admin button.
- Choose how many videos to process in each run with the new batch size setting (Pro).
### Improved
- The video list now clearly notifies you how many videos remain after a batch completes so you can easily run the next set.
- Convenient contact links and your Machine ID are now shown directly on login and update windows.

### Improved
- Update checks are now more reliable when you click the check buttons.

### Improved
- Settings panel now automatically resizes to prevent any controls from being cut off at the edge.
- Layout and spacing of audio volume sliders and checkboxes have been streamlined.
- Scrollbars throughout the app have been given a cleaner, modern look.
